question: Which women are to be recognized as wives and which as others' women?
premises: Only those specified are to be known as wives.
All other women are classified differently.
The others are identified as women belonging to another.
inference: Only those women are to be known as wives; all others are other men's women.
uncertainties: The referent of tā is determined by prior context not included in this verse.
plain_english: Only they are to be known as wives; all other women are the wives of others.
